title: Hame kehti hai duniya wafadarane ghazi
body:
HAME KEHTI HAI DUNIYA WAFADARAN-E-GHAZI
YEHI KMATAM MUSALSAL IBADATH HAI HAMARI
KARAM ABBAS KA HAI
BHARAM ABBAS KA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
ALAM ABBAS KA HAI
BADI PEHCHAN APNI
UDAAO KHAAK UDAAO
LAHU APNA BHAAO
<<DIVIDER>>
JAZA ABBAS DENGE
HAME QHUWWAT MILEGI
HAI MOOMEEN KI ALAMATH
YE MATAM SHAH KI NUSRATH
<<DIVIDER>>
YE MAJLIS KA SALIQA
AATA BINTE NABI KI
BAHATE HAI HAM AANSU
GHAM-E-KARBOBALA MEIN
<<DIVIDER>>
HAMARE SATH HAR DAM
DUA HAI FATIMA KI
KABHI AKBER KA MATAM
KABHI ASGAR KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
KABHI QASIM KE GHAM MEIN
HAMARE ASHK JAARI
LIYE GHAZI KA PARCHAM
KARE PYASAON KA MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
TUMHE MILTI RAHEGI
DUA UMMUL BANEEN KI
YE MATAM KARBALA KA
QAYAMATH TAK RAHEGA
<<DIVIDER>>
EESI MATAM KE PAIHAM
HAME IZZATH MILEGI
TADAP DIL KI YEHI HAI
AZADARAO KI HARDAM
<<DIVIDER>>
KAHEIN ABBAS HAMKO
YE HAI MERE SIPAAHI
YE MATAM ZINDAGI HAI
YE MATAM BANDAGI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
TERA MATAM KARENGE
HAI JAB TAK SAANS BAAQI
RASHEED AB KARBALA MEIN
KAREIN HAM MILKE MATAM
<<DIVIDER>>
BULALE APNE ROUZE
MERE ABBAS-E-GHAZI
